title: Protein drink + creatine
description: One Orgain plant-protein shake (20g protein, 0g sugar, shelf-stable) with 3-5g creatine monohydrate stirred in. Protein is a hard macro for Alan; this is a daily boost + creatine for workouts/clarity. Fuel-frame: it beats the realistic alternative, not a purity object. Line up with workouts when convenient. Creatine also fine in water/OJ if no shake on hand.
